Name: Slime cleaner (Hotkey - K)
Author: Voters25
Description:
[*][quote]❤️ If you found this mod helpful, a coffee would make my day [/quote]


Removes lags and crashes caused by the endless multiplication of slimes in modded locations. It is well suited for clearing locations of thousands of slimes in the Expanded mod. (Hotkey - K)

Move the folder 'Slime cleaner' to the game's Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Slime Cleaner
Manifest.Description: Removes 90% of slimes in the location when pressing the K key
Manifest.Author: Voters25
